title: First-Night Essentials Box: What to Pack Last in Addis Moves
excerpt: Kitchen, bedding, chargers, and toiletries in one labeled box for night one in a new home.
content:
Why one box matters

After a long Addis move day, hunting through dozens of cartons for a charger or kettle ruins night one. Pack a single essentials box last onto the truck so it comes off first at the new home.

What goes inside

  • Phone chargers, power strip, and lamp bulb for the bedroom.
  • Toiletries, towels, and one change of clothes per person.
  • Kettle, instant coffee or tea, snacks, and paper cups.
  • Basic tools: scissors, box cutter, trash bags, tape.
  • Bedding set or sleeping bags if beds are not assembled yet.
  • Kids’ comfort items if moving with children.

Labeling

Mark the carton OPEN FIRST / NIGHT ONE in Amharic and English if movers rotate crews. Keep it with you in the car when possible for high-rise waits at the gate.

Condo and compound moves

Freight lifts may stop before furniture is upstairs—essentials in hand beat waiting for the wardrobe boxes. See condo checklist.

Do not pack in essentials

Passports, lease papers, medications, and jewelry stay in a personal bag—not the essentials carton on the truck tail.

After movers leave

Set up bed and kitchen first; unpack room-by-room tomorrow. Pair with move-out handover if you still owe keys at the old unit.

Load order

Tell the crew lead the essentials carton loads last and unloads first. Tape a bright label on all four sides so it is not buried under dining chairs in the truck.
